title: MV how to get around the skill type window?

posts.author: maydayrailway
posts.body:
hi! i was wondering if there's a way to completely remove the skill type window from the skill scene, since in only use one and think it's pretty redundant (and it's taking up space)
thanks in advance! pictured below is the window i want to remove, ideally i'd want to get straight into the skill selection window when i select the skill menu from the pause menu.
sorry if this is a common request, but i couldnt find any threads on this for mv @_@

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
you'll need a plugin to change the menu.
there are actually many plugins to change different aspects of the menu, but because this is usually on personal preferences only very few are for general distribution.
report your topßic to have it moved to plugin requests.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
With
Hime's Actor Battle commands
and
Battle Command Use Skill
, you can pretty much just put the skill right in the same window where the attack and Item commands are. Or just not give access to the skill command.
